scope: Static source, source artwork and resource-reference inspection; no build, app run, real permission prompt or RTC validation
nativeMessagingGate: Signed in, not hidden or blocked, mutually following; draft retained when locked
nativeCallGate: Checked before presentation, before permissions and after asynchronous results; invalidated on follow loss, hidden or blocked profile, sign-out or account switch
firstPermissionDenial: Close the current preparation without further prompts
previouslyDeniedPermission: Inline neutral explanation with an optional user-tapped Settings button
cameraPreview: Front camera initially, mirrored self-preview, camera off and front/back switch, no uploads
captureLifetime: Stops on exit, background, interrupted capture or lost mutual follow; explicit action required to resume
connectionBoundary: No RTC transport or remote answering is implemented; interface always says Not connected
artwork: Original Host-Native generation, source PNGs and prompts in ProjectMaterials/TableCalls; two runtime PNGs in TableArtwork.xcassets
helpDeployment: Updated source and interface import artifact only; existing remote help requires re-importing the interface template
